name: Plane-Based Sampling
definition: A method to improve the traditional Ray Casting Algorithm (RCA) for fast reconstruction of 3D biomedical models from sequential images. It calculates the optical properties of all sampling points based on the intersection points when a ray travels through an equidistant parallel plan cluster of the volume dataset, rather than interpolating within every voxel individually.
summary: Plane-Based Sampling is a ray casting optimization that replaces per-voxel interpolation with ray-plane intersections and proportional interpolation, reducing computational cost while maintaining image density.
